:::{#def-vector-addition}
#### Vector addition

The **sum** of two column vectors $\vx$ and $\vy$ of the same length $p$
is the column vector $\vx + \vy$ of length $p$
obtained by adding entry by entry:

$$(\vx + \vy)_i \eqdef x_i + y_i, \quad i = 1, \ldots, p$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-vector-addition}
#### Adding two vectors

$$
\begin{aligned}
\begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}
+
\begin{bmatrix} 4 \\ 5 \\ 6 \end{bmatrix}
&=
\begin{bmatrix} 1 + 4 \\ 2 + 5 \\ 3 + 6 \end{bmatrix} \\
&=
\begin{bmatrix} 5 \\ 7 \\ 9 \end{bmatrix}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
